Bounded display interval may truncate a longer leader spell at an existing framework boundary; preserve original source start/end in provenance. Source ENDDATE remains unchanged: conservative exclusive display cutoff omits the final coded day instead of assuming inclusive semantics. Literal dataset leader label retained, without an invented name expansion. Uncertain framework-start years/months are excluded from research coverage.

Source literal name is retained, including surname-only labels and original spelling; no full-name expansion or correction is inferred.
